Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
<joris@csc.albany.edu> wrote:
>	Say, Can you press out of a trap with a card such as nimble
>feet or Boxed in?

Trap simply gives each appropriate round of combat a free press to
continue.  This press can be cancelled normally, including with
Nimble Feet or Boxed In.  The other player may then press to continue
after all, and so on.  Assuming the end result is "press to end combat",
the combat ends, in spite of the Trap.
